{{< include ../macros.qmd >}}

Surprisal: $\surprisalf{x}$, $\surprisalf{\frac{a}{b}}^2$, $\surprisal_i$.

Surprisal under a named distribution: $\surprisalunderf{q}{x}$, $\surprisalunderf{q}{\frac{a}{b}}^2$.

Divergence: $\kldivf{p}{q}$, $\kldivf{\frac{a}{b}}{q}^2$, $\kldiv_{\param_0}$.

Cross-entropy: $\crossentropyf{p}{q}$, $\crossentropyf{\frac{a}{b}}{q}^2$, $\crossentropy_{\param_0}$.

Rarity: $\rarityf{x}$, $\rarityf{\frac{a}{b}}^2$, $\rarity_i$, $\rarityunderf{q}{\frac{a}{b}}^2$.

Complementary probability: $\cprob{p}$, $\cprob{\frac{a}{b}}^2$, $\cprob{\P(A)}$.

Perplexity: $\perplexityf{X}$, $\perplexityf{\frac{a}{b}}^2$, $\perplexity_q$.

Mutual information: $\mutinfof{X}{Y}$, $\mutinfof{\frac{a}{b}}{Y}^2$, $\mutinfo_i$, $\cmutinfof{X}{Y}{Z}$, $\cmutinfof{\frac{a}{b}}{Y}{Z}^2$, $\mutinfoatf{z}{X}{Y}$, $\mutinfoatf{z}{\frac{a}{b}}{Y}^2$.

Rényi entropy: $\renyientropyf{2}{X}$, $\renyientropyf{\alpha}{\frac{a}{b}}^2$, $\renyientropy_2$.

Distribution functions, which need the lowercase blackboard letters from `bbm`: $\p(x)$, $\f(x)$, $\h(x)$, $\F(x)$, $\S(x)$, $\Q(u)$, $\H(x)$, $\entropyf{X}$.
